If you're looking for a battery backup with a built-in power conditioner, you want a UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) with Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR) and power filtering.

A good unit combines three functions:

Battery backup: Keeps equipment running during power outages.

Voltage regulation (AVR): Corrects voltage fluctuations without using the battery.

Power conditioning: Helps filter electrical noise and protect against surges.

chats.answer:
If you're looking for a battery backup with a built-in power conditioner, you want a UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) with Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR) and power filtering.

These devices combine three functions:

Battery backup: Keeps equipment running during power outages.

Voltage regulation (AVR): Corrects moderate voltage fluctuations without using the battery.

Power conditioning: Helps protect equipment from surges and electrical noise.

For computers, networking equipment, home theaters, and sensitive electronics, I recommend looking at pure sine wave UPS systems, especially line-interactive or online double-conversion models.
